summary: Western Alliance Bancorporation filed an 8-K reporting the declaration of quarterly cash dividends on its common and preferred stock. The board declared a $0.42 per share common dividend payable May 29, 2026 to holders of record May 14, 2026, and a $106.25 per share preferred dividend (equivalent to $0.265625 per depositary share) payable June 30, 2026 to holders of record June 15, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration and does not constitute a special-situation event. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or other transformative corporate action is described.
